title: Giotto docs
subtitle: You ask. Your agent draws. You watch it happen.

elements.text: You ask. Your agent draws. You watch it happen.
This page is one Giotto diagram, played. Scroll to follow along  ↓

content.text: Your agent already knows your code. Ask in plain words; the diagram opens in your browser.
Keep asking. It changes just what you asked for, and keeps what you moved by hand.
Drag over part of the diagram and say what should change there. Your agent knows exactly which boxes you mean.
Grab any box: arrows follow and find their way around. Your agent sees where you put it and leaves it there.
Ask for an animation: requests travel along the arrows, boxes fill in, a narration plays. It exports as a video or an SVG that plays on GitHub.
Every diagram follows one style. Ask for a new look, or pick one from the gallery.
Every change is saved as a version: your agent’s and yours. Bring any of them back; nothing is lost.
Not everything is boxes and arrows. Ask for a card, a poster or a chart: same colors, same history, exported as a PNG.
When it looks right, ask for a file. Your agent checks the picture before it hands it over.
Claude Code, Codex and any agent that speaks MCP. In ChatGPT and Claude, the diagram shows up right in the chat.
Then ask your agent for a diagram. The first time, it sets Giotto up and asks you to restart the session once. Needs git and Node.js 20+.
